description: Restore the Hivemind project pin, auto-start its session bus listener, and report new messages on subsequent prompts.

hooks.command: bash -c 'for d in "$MUSE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PLUGIN_ROOT"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/hooks/session_start.py" ] && exec python3 "$d/hooks/session_start.py"; done; exit 0'

bash -c 'for d in "$MUSE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PLUGIN_ROOT"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/skills/hivemind/scripts/bus-autojoin.py" ] && exec python3 "$d/skills/hivemind/scripts/bus-autojoin.py" --platform muse --mode ensure; done; exit 0'
